facts.fact: 开篇：这房子本有许多理想之处。
facts.anchor: It was, in many ways, an ideal house.
It felt so solvable to Kate, the answers tantalisingly close.

facts.fact: 轻松找到 Alice 的 Facebook。
facts.anchor: She found Alice Wheatley on Facebook easily enough.

facts.fact: 从 Benson Stansfield 网站拿邮箱发信。
facts.anchor: Found her email address on the website of her law firm, Benson Stansfield, and sent her a message.

facts.fact: Gloria 以 Crawley 家聚会为 Aiden 作保。
Gloria 断言：入室盗窃失手。
这是她的故事，不是他的。
facts.anchor: It was that this was still her story, not his.
Even if he had just told her he loved her.
